bundle.shortDescription: Live monitor for local llama.cpp servers and NVIDIA GPUs
bundle.longDescription: A read-only desktop monitor for a local llama.cpp inference server and the NVIDIA GPUs on the same machine, showing live server status, models and slots, per-model performance metrics, GPU telemetry and locally stored history.
